g.text: POST /api/maintenance-templates (name, type, applicableModels, checklist, flightHoursInterval?, calendarDaysInterval?)
POST /api/maintenance-records (aircraftRegistration, templateId, description, startDate, expectedDurationMinutes, component?)
Every request carries "Authorization: Bearer <JWT>"; the JWT is forwarded to Aircraft Management
and to the peer replicas (+ X-Service-Key). "System" = any of the 3 replicas: every GET answers
with the data of all replicas (X-Partial-Response: true when a replica did not answer).
